hook: Raat ke do baje woh chaukhat par tel maangne aaya tha!
hook_text: 2 AM ka diya bujhne mat dena
feedback: 1. Pacing & Length: At 13 cuts and 55 seconds, it's slightly under target cut count (16-24 cuts) and runs slow. Add 3-5 rapid reaction shots (Savita's trembling fingers, cold mist swirling around feet, the shadow towering closer) between cuts 6 and 9 to create breathless peak tension. 2. Rhythm & Structure: Cut 2 mentions Saas shouting 'diya bujhna nahi chahiye', but Cut 4 has her calmly commanding 'aaj teri baari hai'—smooth this timeline transition so Cut 2 feels like a distinct flash-forward or quote. 3. Emotion: Before Savita is thrust outside, give us 4 seconds of vulnerability—a glimpse
lines: Raat ke do baje woh chaukhat par tel maangne aaya tha!
Sasu-bai ne cheekhkar kaha tha, 'Diya bujhna nahi chahiye!'
Khed Shivapur ke us puraane aangan par Poonam ki sard raat chhaayi thi.
Savita, baahar jaa… aaj teri baari hai.
Ganne ke kheton se bhaari kadmon ki awaaz nazdeek aane lagi.
Darwaaze par woh das feet ka kaala saaya khada tha.
Savita ne kaanpte haathon se diye ki lau ko chhupaaya.
Magar khidki ke paar… uska pati uski shaadi ki chunri par kaala dhaaga baandh raha tha.
Diye ke peetal par teen pichhli bahuon ke naam khude the!
Diya ghar bachaane ke liye nahi… uski jaan ki aahuti dene ke liye tha.
Aaj raat agar koi tumhe sarson ka diya thamaaye, toh kabhi haath mat lagaana.
